facts.text: Walden provides Tempo Learning, an online self-paced competency-based education format where students advance by demonstrating mastery rather than spending fixed time in courses.

sources.title: Flexibility Designed for Working Adults - Walden University
sources.quote: Tempo Learning® is a self-paced, competency-based education format. This allows you to advance by mastering specific skills and knowledge rather than spending a fixed amount of time in courses.

facts.text: Through the Accelerate Into Master's (AIM) program, bachelor's students can take master's-level courses and reduce total master's credit requirements by up to 50%.

sources.title: Accelerate Into Master's (AIM) Program | Walden University
sources.quote: Through Walden's AIM option, you can take master's-level classes as a bachelor's student. This reduces your total master's credit requirements in your chosen program by up to 50%, saving you significant time and money
